def transform(grid):
    # Read the color clues at the beginnings of each panel row. A uniform
    # 7-cell separator row/column marks panel boundaries; reduce panels to
    # the color encoded by their top-left clue cell (4 denotes 5 here).
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    divc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + divr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + divc + [w]
    rows = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]) if a+1 < b]
    cols = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(cb,cb[1:]) if a+1 < b]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rows:
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in cols:
            # The clue is in the first cell of the top border; marker 4
            # stands for the region's color, as demonstrated by 5.
            clue = grid[r0-1][c0] if r0 else grid[r0][c0]
            row.append(5 if clue in (4,5) else clue)
        out.append(row)
    return out
